verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs claim a 'Restricted Mode' meant to prevent third-party code execution, which could imply some isolation for testing plugins/agents, but hands-on community evidence explicitly states there is no sandboxing at all—every plugin has full filesystem and network access—directly contradicting any notion of a safe test environment separate from production data. missing for 10: a documented test/sandbox vault mode, evidence of isolated agent execution, and confirmation that restricted mode actually blocks filesystem/network access.
